findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a mop to be stored in soiled mop water in the back room of the facility. Education was conducted regarding mop storage, and the mop was moved to the straining basin of the bucket. Ensure the mop head is stored in a manner that allows for dripping and air-drying when not in use. Storing the mop in soiled water can result in contamination of the mop with microbial growth.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.
